correctness.rationale: Exhaustive restricted-growth recursion with a proved one-step completeness invariant enumerates every strict ternary 7/8 word at all lengths through 28. Exact integer LCS tests use 16*LCS<7*(combined length). Independent square-free-first enumeration checks 5162 and 6740 candidate words at lengths 27/28 using different LCS DP, matching exactly two/zero with initial symbol zero. All 3276 triples of the canonical extremizer were compared as exact fractions and give maximum gap 3/23 with precisely two witnesses. Prefix inheritance proves all lengths above 28 impossible. No finite sampling is extrapolated to an infinite statement without this lemma.

originality.rationale: The exact strict 1/8 ternary length barrier at 27, the six-word orbit, and the maximum gap 3/23 are not implied by the inspected existence/asymptotic constructions or equal-length LCS approximate-square results. Comparisons include alternative formulations, stronger coverage, available tabulations and direct implication tests. This is novelty within inspected evidence, not a claim of literature-wide uniqueness.

value.rationale: The 2026 ternary existence breakthrough explicitly leaves quantitative gap optimization open. A complete exact threshold at the strong gap 1/8, the last feasible length 27, the exact maximal 27-letter gap 3/23, and a unique symmetry orbit give a motivated nontrivial finite feasibility cutoff and benchmark, rather than a random table entry. This supplies finite-scale obstruction information independently meaningful even without proving an all-length optimum.
